description:
Web Spiders Group is looking for a highly driven Marketing Manager who can own and execute end\-to\-end marketing initiatives to drive brand visibility, lead generation, customer acquisition, and product adoption across global markets.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2 \- 6 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**Education** 
 : MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a reputed B\-School preferred
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Strategic Marketing \& Brand Building**
* Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business objectives and revenue goals.
* Build brand awareness for Web Spiders, SpiderX AI, and other company offerings across domestic and international markets.
* Define product positioning, messaging, and value propositions for AI, Voice AI, SaaS, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Collaborate with leadership, sales, product, and customer success teams to create go\-to\-market strategies.


 ‍
   

  

**Demand Generation \& Growth Marketing**
* Plan and execute multi\-channel lead generation campaigns.
* Drive inbound marketing initiatives through content, SEO, SEM, social media, webinars, email marketing, and marketing automation.
* Develop account\-based marketing (ABM) campaigns targeting enterprise decision\-makers.
* Manage performance marketing campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other relevant channels.
* Monitor marketing funnel metrics and optimize conversion rates.


 ‍
   

  

**Product Marketing**
* Lead product launch campaigns and market expansion initiatives.
* Create sales enablement materials including brochures, presentations, case studies, whitepapers, and product collateral.
* Conduct competitor analysis, customer research, and market intelligence activities.
* Work closely with product teams to translate technical capabilities into compelling business value propositions.


 ‍
   

  

**Content \& Digital Marketing**
* Own the company’s digital presence across websites, blogs, social media platforms, and industry communities.
* Develop high\-quality content strategies focused on AI, Voice AI, Customer Experience, SaaS, and enterprise technology.
* Coordinate with internal and external content creators, designers, and agencies.
* Improve website traffic, engagement, and lead conversion through data\-driven initiatives.


 ‍
   

  

**Events, Partnerships \& PR**
* Plan and execute webinars, virtual events, industry conferences, and customer engagement programs.
* Build relationships with industry associations, media partners, analysts, and technology partners.
* Support PR, thought leadership, and executive branding initiatives.


 ‍
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting**
* Define and track marketing KPIs including MQLs, SQLs, pipeline contribution, CAC, ROI, and campaign performance.
* Prepare regular reports and recommendations for senior management.
* Utilize marketing analytics tools to identify growth opportunities and optimize campaign effectiveness.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 ‍
   

  

**Must Have**
* 2\+ years of experience in B2B marketing, SaaS marketing, technology marketing, or digital marketing.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, demand generation, and digital marketing channels.
* Experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, email marketing, and social platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make marketing decisions.
* Experience using CRM and marketing automation tools.


 ‍
   

  

**Preferred**
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a reputed B\-School.
* Experience marketing AI, SaaS, Enterprise Software, Voice AI, CX Technology, or IT Services.
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
* Exposure to international B2B markets including North America, UK, APAC, or Middle East.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced startup or product\-led technology environment.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match \& offer

description:
**Company Description** 
 Brandatory is a modern creative branding and digital marketing agency focused on crafting exceptional digital experiences for clients across industries. With over 5 years of experience and more than 250 successful projects, the agency has built a strong reputation for delivering impactful results. Brandatory serves clients in 15\+ countries and is growing as one of the promising digital marketing companies in Kolkata. Team members collaborate in a dynamic, design\-driven environment that values innovation, accountability, and measurable outcomes.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sr. Social Media Manager role based in Kolkata. The Social Media Manager will plan, create, and publish content across key social media platforms, ensuring brand consistency and audience engagement. Daily tasks include developing and executing social media strategies, managing posting calendars, monitoring performance metrics, and optimizing campaigns through Social Media Optimization (SMO) techniques. The role involves collaborating with designers, copywriters, and account managers, responding to audience interactions, and staying current with platform trends and best practices to support clients’ marketing goals.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in Social Media Marketing and Social Media Optimization (SMO), with experience managing brand profiles across major platforms.
* Ability to develop and implement effective Content Strategy aligned with broader marketing objectives.
* Excellent Communication and Writing skills for creating clear, engaging, and brand\-appropriate social content.
* Familiarity with social media analytics tools and basic knowledge of digital marketing metrics (reach, engagement, conversions).
* Relevant experience in agency or brand\-side social media management; experience in creative or digital marketing environments is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort working on\-site in a collaborative, fast\-paced team setting in Kolkata.

title: Specialist Executive Manager- Brand, Marketing & Communication-Copywriter
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Executive Manager—Copywriter
   

  

 If you’re a marketer, creative, communicator, storyteller, or strategist, our unique blend of talented pros needs one more ingredient:you. Deloitte’s full\-service Brand, Marketing \& Communications organization is seeking collaborative creatives, skilful strategists, and marketing masterminds to lead our businesses in exciting new directions. At Deloitte, we combine world\-class creativity and business knowledge, insightful strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s powerful brand equity to create undeniable impact. If you find opportunity where others don’t, thrive in a supportive and diverse team environment, keep your finger on the pulse of cultural trends and the latest technology, and apply new ideas to challenge the status quo, then we want your talents in our mix. Together we’ll discover new ways to transform out\-of\-the\-box concepts into work that feels like marketing magic.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll contribute to the growth and development of the organization in a variety of ways. Everyday you’ll have the opportunity to use your skills to bring big ideas to life. We celebrate inquisitive team players who can regularly anticipate, adjust, and act in a rapidly changing market and marketing landscape—and find new opportunities within it.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 As a Specialist Executive Manager,Copy on the Marketing, Brand \& Communications team, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Lead the creative and editorial direction for large, high\-visibility, cross\-channel campaigns and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with creative directors, senior marketing and business leaders to define communications priorities, shape messaging strategies, and guide creative approaches for complex business issues.
* Provide senior\-level counsel to stakeholders on brand, messaging, audience strategy, and campaign effectiveness.
* Oversee the development of campaign copy and creative narratives across channels, including web, social, email, video, experiential, thought leadership, executive communications, and major brand initiatives.
* Set and uphold the highest standards for creative excellence, editorial rigor, and brand consistency across the portfolio.
* Drive innovation in how the team uses approved AI tools, new channels, and emerging creative practices to improve quality, efficiency, and scale.
* Lead managers and senior creatives, providing direction, coaching, and developmental feedback to strengthen team capability and succession.
* Build trusted relationships across a matrixed organization and influence outcomes with senior stakeholders in the US market.
* Oversee complex project portfolios, balancing business priorities, resourcing, timelines, and changing stakeholder requirements.
* Lead internal strategic initiatives, capability\-building efforts, and continuous improvement across the creative function.
* Manage external agencies, freelancers, and specialist partners, as needed.


 The team
   

  

 Deloitte’s Creative team within the Growth and Purpose office brings together the strength of Deloitte’s brand and the expertise of inspired marketing and creative professionals to deliver meaningful business impact. By combining strategic insight with world\-class creative thinking, the team develops compelling, data\-informed work that supports key business priorities. When stakeholders need next\-level solutions that support their business priorities, Brand, Marketing \& Communications is the partner that can transform big ideas into big impact.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru
   

  

 Work timing: 2:00 PM–11:00 PM (IST)
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Advertising, Marketing, English, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of in\-house or agency experience leading integrated, cross\-channel campaigns, with a compelling portfolio of distinctive work.
* A diverse portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop, lead, and elevate campaigns on complex B2B subjects for the US market in English; portfolio submission required.
* Proven ability to operate successfully in a matrixed environment and build trusted relationships across a diverse group of colleagues and senior US\-based stakeholders.
* Strong conceptual and strategic thinking, with the ability to balance creativity and innovation with business priorities and proof points.
* Executive presence, with the ability to present ideas, make recommendations, provide clear rationale, and advise leaders on communications and marketing strategy.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, delegating work, and providing high\-quality creative feedback that improves output and develops talent.
* Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, including the ability to distill complex and emerging topics into clear, compelling language.
* Fluency across digital and traditional channels, including social, content, and video.
* Proven ability to manage multiple high\-priority initiatives and competing deadlines with minimal oversight.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, or other B2B marketing environments preferred.
* Ability to travel as needed.


 \#BMC\_Creative
   

  

 \#CAL\-PM
   

  

 \#CAL\-SD
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**A little bit about us** 




  





 Around Always is a premium handcrafted footwear and accessories D2C brand focused on bridal, festive, and occasion wear. We work with in\-house design, embroidery and manufacturing units to create made\-to\-order, comfort\-first footwear for bride \& groom across India and globally.
 



  





 (www.aroundalways.com \| Instagram (93K\+ Followers): around.always)
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Content PlanningPlan monthly content calendars aligned to product launches, wedding season timelines, and campaign moments.
* Conceptualisation and ExecutionConceptualise and pitch original ideas for Reels, carousels, product shots, and behind\-the\-scenes content and then execute them yourself.
* Shoot product and lifestyle content independently, including texture close\-ups, styled setups, and model or hand\-model shoots when needed
* EditingEdit short\-form video for Instagram Reels with cuts, transitions, music sync, text overlays, and colour grading.
* Edit static and carousel content for feed crop safety for Meta formats, basic retouching, and layout.
* Write captions and hooks that feel warm, aspirational, and distinctly “Around Always”.
* Acing the GameTrack content performance \- saves, shares, reach and use the data to improve what you make next.
* Stay ahead of trending audio and formats, adapting them to the brand’s aesthetic before they peak.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




  




* A portfolio of Reels or short\-form videos where you personally planned, shot, and edited the content.
* A strong visual eye you notice texture, proportion, and light, especially in product or craft\-led contexts.
* Solid video editing skills on software like CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent.
* Comfort with static and graphic editing on Lightroom, Canva, or Photoshop.
* A real understanding of what drives organic reach on Instagram: Saves, shares, audio trends, and hook strength.
* Ability to work independently in a small, founder\-led team without needing a separate photographer or creative director.



  





  





**Process** 




  




* We promise to keep it simple. Send your resume (\+ brief introduction) to info@aroundalways.com
* Interview with leadership
* Get feedback and get on\-board



  





 CTC: 2\.5 – 3\.5 Lac p.a. (all inclusive)LET’S CHAT!

title: Field Marketing Representative
description:
Field Marketing Representative
   

 Company: Mercury Educare
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Location: Kolkata
   

 Work Mode: In\-Person / Field\-Based
   

 About Mercury Educare
   

 Mercury Educare is an education and skill\-development organization focused on helping students and institutions access industry\-relevant training, AI education, vocational programs, career development initiatives, and employment\-oriented opportunities.
   

 We work with colleges, educational institutions, training institutes, industry partners, and other organizations to bring practical, career\-focused training programs directly to students and institutions.
   

 We are looking for a dynamic, confident, and target\-oriented Field Marketing Representative who can build institutional relationships, visit colleges and institutes, generate business opportunities, and close partnerships for our training programs.
   

 Job Responsibilities
   

 1\. College \& Institute Marketing
   

 Visit colleges, universities, educational institutes, and training centers across Kolkata and nearby areas.
   

 Meet with principals, directors, placement officers, department heads, training \& placement teams, and other decision\-makers.
   

 Present Mercury Educare's AI training, skill\-development programs, vocational courses, career programs, and other training solutions.
   

 Identify institutional requirements and recommend suitable training programs.
   

 2\. Business Development \& Deal Closing
   

 Generate new institutional leads through field visits, networking, referrals, events, and direct outreach.
   

 Conduct meetings and presentations with college/institute management.
   

 Negotiate and close training partnerships, workshops, seminars, certification programs, and institutional training deals.
   

 Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective colleges and institutes.
   

 3\. Channel Partner Development
   

 Identify and onboard Channel Partners, Education Consultants, Training Partners, and Local Representatives.
   

 Build long\-term relationships with channel partners for student and institutional lead generation.
   

 Develop new business opportunities through the partner network.
   

 Achieve channel\-partner acquisition and revenue targets.
   

 4\. Student \& Institutional Engagement
   

 Organize and coordinate seminars, workshops, career awareness sessions, AI awareness programs, and training events in colleges and institutes.
   

 Explain program benefits, career opportunities, certifications, and employment relevance to students and institutional stakeholders.
   

 Support student mobilization and enrollment wherever required.
   

 5\. Relationship Management
   

 Develop strong relationships with colleges, institutes, placement cells, faculty members, management teams, and channel partners.
   

 Regularly follow up with prospects and existing partners.
   

 Maintain long\-term institutional relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.
   

 6\. Reporting \& Target Achievement
   

 Maintain records of field visits, meetings, leads, proposals, follow\-ups, partnerships, and closures.
   

 Submit regular sales and activity reports.
   

 Consistently work toward monthly lead\-generation, partnership, and revenue targets.
   

 Desired Candidate Profile
   

 Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
   

 0–3 years of experience in field marketing, business development, education sales, institutional sales, admissions, training sales, or a related field.
   

 Freshers with excellent communication, confidence, and sales ability may also apply.
   

 Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
   

 Comfortable visiting colleges and institutes on a regular basis.
   

 Should be confident in meeting senior institutional decision\-makers.
   

 Ability to generate leads independently and convert prospects into business partnerships.
   

 Target\-oriented and willing to work in a field\-sales environment.
   

 Knowledge of MS Office, Google Sheets, CRM/reporting tools is an advantage.
   

 Candidates with existing networks in colleges, institutes, education consultancies, or training organizations will be preferred.
   

 What We Offer
   

 Opportunity to work in the growing AI, Education \& Skill Development sector.
   

 Exposure to institutional sales and B2B business development.
   

 Opportunity to build a strong professional network across colleges and educational institutions.
   

 Career growth and performance\-based incentives.
   

 Dynamic and growth\-oriented work environment.
   

 Opportunity to contribute to expanding access to AI and industry\-relevant training for students.
   

 Who We Are Looking For
   

 We are looking for someone who is not limited to generating leads but can take ownership of the complete business\-development cycle:
   

 College Visit → Decision\-Maker Meeting → Presentation → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Partnership → Deal Closure
   

 If you are confident, energetic, comfortable with fieldwork, and enjoy meeting people, building relationships, and closing deals, this role is for you.
   

 Join Mercury Educare and help us build partnerships with educational institutions while creating new opportunities for students through AI and skill\-based training.
   

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who is
 **not limited to generating leads** 
 but can take ownership of the complete business\-development cycle:
   

**College Visit → Decision\-Maker Meeting → Presentation → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Partnership → Deal Closure**
 If you are confident, energetic, comfortable with fieldwork, and enjoy
 **meeting people, building relationships, and closing deals** 
 , this role is for you.
   

**Join Mercury Educare and help us build partnerships with educational institutions while creating new opportunities for students through AI and skill\-based training.**

title: MS-Microsoft Business Applications Lead-Executive Director
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Name\- GDS Consulting \- Microsoft Business Applications Leader \- GTM, Delivery and Alliance Management**
**Position Summary**
 Microsoft Alliance is part of EY's broader strategy to work with leading technology providers to deliver innovative solutions that help clients navigate the complexities of the digital world. Through such alliances, consulting is better equipped to support clients in achieving their strategic objectives and driving digital success. Microsoft Business Applications practice at GDS focuses on leveraging Microsoft's suite of business applications to help clients optimize their operations and transform their businesses.
   

  

 To strengthen our capability and brand, the following are the underpinning aspects
   

  

* A world class global delivery capability on Microsoft Business Applications with focus on FS \& non FS segments in areas – Americas,
* EMEIA and APAC
* The ability for GDS to own and drive strategic initiatives by playing an active role in various Fields of play for both G\-360 \& Core Accounts For FY 25 and beyond, Microsoft Business Application (Biz Apps) is seeing huge potential across domains like Finance, Risk, Supply Chain, HR and across both Financial \& Commercial Sectors. The long\-term goal is to expand its footprint in not just having capability but having significant presence in Sector Solutions and Field of Play offerings of EY. Microsoft Biz Apps Leader is needed at GDS to provide vision, drive growth, maintain excellence in delivery, and ensure that clients receive the best possible solutions to their business challenges using Microsoft technologies.


 GDS Microsoft Biz Apps Leader will have responsibilities across following key focus areas,
   

  

* Leadership \& Strategy
+ Define and execute a comprehensive strategy for Microsoft Business Applications, aligning with overall business goals and market opportunities.
+ Lead and mentor teams responsible for delivery, pre\-sales, and solution architecture within the Microsoft Business Applications domain.
+ Drive organizational growth by leveraging Microsoft Business Apps as a core strategic pillar.

* Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Management
+ Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
+ Partner global and regional Microsoft Biz Apps champion to win large engagements from current deal $225 MN in FY 25 to $375 MN by FY 28 with YoY growth of 18%.
+ Collaborate with other partner firms within EY and establish value propositions and solutions that resonate with target clients.
+ Engage with clients to evangelize Microsoft Business Apps and address critical business needs.
+ Engage with Microsoft alliance partners to drive growth

* Delivery Management
+ Oversee the successful delivery of projects
+ Expand the GTM and Delivery team with mix of Associate Directors, Senior Manager, Managers and below with target team size of 650 by FY 28
+ Applications projects, ensuring timely execution, high quality, and client satisfaction.
+ Establish best practices for project delivery, including process improvements, risk management, and quality assurance.
+ Work closely with technical teams to ensure alignment with delivery goals and client requirements.

* Alliance \& Partnership Management
+ Act as the primary liaison between EY and Microsoft, nurturing the alliance to maximize mutual benefits.
+ Identify opportunities for co\-selling, joint initiatives, and strategic investments with Microsoft.
+ Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Microsoft and other relevant partners to enhance partnership performance.

* Technology Expertise
+ Demonstrate an in\-depth understanding of Microsoft Business Applications, including Dynamics 365 (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate), and Azure.
+ Stay up to date with new features, releases, and advancements in the Microsoft ecosystem and communicate these insights effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

* Business Growth \& Innovation
+ Leverage your industry exp


**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Leadership and team management, including talent acquisition, development, and retention
* Works with EY teams to ensure One Microsoft approach
* Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365,
* Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
* Technical oversight and quality assurance of deliverables
* Standardizes, simplifies, and modernizes the delivery practices
* Business development and client relationship management
* Financial management of the practice's operations


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**
* Professional with the ability to make most of the decisions pertaining to practice growth, investment in new areas of technology and people issues
* Defining location strategy with respect to global locations, building integrated operating model, identifying right pricing, and acquiring local talent
* Sharp focus on building competitive cost of delivery
* Defining winning themes and building differentiated solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field with 20 years of experience. Graduate from top colleges is a huge plus
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 and Power Platforms with technical delivery experience in Dynamics 365 CRM App, PowerApps,
* Power platform, Front and Back\-office integrations, Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Experience of managing practice/accounts with HC above 200\+ would be a huge plus
* Demonstrated record in driving revenue within existing clients and in developing new prospects at the “C” level of Fortune 500 companies
* Demonstrated ability to work successfully within a matrixed organization and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering advisory services.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Technology expertise, in Microsoft solutions focused on D365 and power platforms, 20 years across roles spanning client delivery, innovation, solution architecting, people, and program management. At least last 10\+ years in technical leadership roles
* Demonstrates Dynamics and Power Platform technical expertise including associated Microsoft stack implementation technologies such as Azure, SharePoint, and Exchange/Outlook, with a proven ability to sell and execute large scale consulting engagements with a distributed delivery mindset
* Strong reputation in the talent market and the ability to build a strong \& continuous talent pipeline, based on one’s reputation and prior successes.
* Competitive intelligence about Big4 and Microsoft skills landscape
* Specialized industry\-sector experience in at least one or two sectors relevant to EY like Consumer products \& Retail, Technology, Media \& Entertainment, Telecom, Advanced Manufacturing \& Mobility, Oil and Gas, Government and infrastructure


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
